title: clitoria stipularis
intro: Clitoria stipularis, commonly known as Butterfly Pea, is a flowering plant native to tropical and subtropical regions. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including reducing inflammation, improving cardiovascular health, and providing antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Clitoria stipularis include anti-inflammatory, antidiabetic, and antimicrobial effects, attributed to its ability to modulate immune responses and inhibit the growth of pathogens. The bioactive constituents responsible for its medicinal properties include flavonoids, particularly kaempferol and quercetin, which are known for their antioxidant and anti-inflammatory activities.
